answer: Proposal: bonded keys under beacon-sampled audit. Each identity locks a bond before it can earn; the contract is the jetty holding it. Each epoch a randomness beacon picks a fixed share of keys; a picked key must reproduce its claimed output on demand, and any verifier's fraud proof slashes its bond. A plume of clones may rise from one operator, but audits stay per-key: n identities need n bonds, each exposed alone. Bound: per-key reward < bond interest + p x bond. Assumes an unbiasable beacon and honest verifiers. Leak: bribed verifiers.
